"},"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/README":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/README","text":"! HUPedia HUPedia er et *plugin* med artikeltyper og dataskabeloner. Selve udseendet er et separat *tema* (`$:/themes/huwiki/hupedia`). Tilføj et af taggene `HUPedia/Person`, `HUPedia/Sted`, `HUPedia/Begivenhed`, `HUPedia/Organisation`, `HUPedia/Musikværk`, `HUPedia/Begreb` eller `HUPedia/Artikel`. Tiddleren får en passende faktaboks og redigeringsformular, når HUPedia-temaet er aktivt. `PediaArtikel` fra den gamle udgave genkendes som standardartikel uden datatab. Andre tags til emner er stadig mulige. Ved skift til et andet tema beholdes alle felter, men de særlige faktabokse/formularer vil normalt ikke blive vist. "},"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/kind.js":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/kind.js","type":"application/javascript","module-type":"filteroperator","text":"/* Shared tag precedence for article views and edit forms. */ "use strict"; var kinds = [ ["Person"], ["Sted", "Place"], ["Begivenhed", "Event"], ["Organisation", "Organization"], ["Musikværk", "MusicalWork"], ["Begreb", "Concept"], ["Artikel", "Article"] ]; exports["hupedia-kind"] = function(source, operator, options) { var output = []; source(function(tiddler, title) { if (!tiddler || String(title).indexOf("$:/") === 0) { return; } var tags = tiddler.fields.tags || []; for (var i = 0; i < kinds.length; i++) { var matches = kinds[i].some(function(kind) { return tags.indexOf("HUPedia/" + kind) >= 0; }); if (matches) { output.push(kinds[i][0]); return; } } if (tags.indexOf("PediaArtikel") >= 0) { output.push("Artikel"); } }); return output; }; "},"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/article-view":{"title":"$:/plugins/huwiki/hupedia/article-view","type":"text/vnd.tiddlywiki","text":"\whitespace trim

container-type: inline-size; } .hupedia-infobox { float: right; box-sizing: border-box; width: 18rem; max-width: 46%; margin: 0 0 1.25rem 1.5rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--hupedia-border, #a2a9b1); background: var(--hupedia-surface, #f8f9fa); color: var(--hupedia-text, #202122); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; } .hupedia-infobox h3 { margin: 0 0 1rem; padding: 0.65rem; background: var(--hupedia-accent-soft, #dbe6f2); font: bold 1.15em Georgia, serif; text-align: center; } .hupedia-infobox dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 0.8fr) minmax(0, 1.2fr); gap: 0.6rem 0.75rem; margin: 0; } .hupedia-infobox dt { font-weight: 700; } .hupedia-infobox dt, .hupedia-infobox dd { min-width: 0; margin: 0; overflow-wrap: break-word; } .hupedia-article-text > :first-child { margin-top: 0; } .hupedia-backlinks { clear: both; margin-top: 1.5rem; padding-top: 0.85rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--hupedia-border, #c8ccd1); color: var(--hupedia-muted, #54595d); font-size: 0.9em; } .hupedia-backlinks ul { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem 1.5rem; margin: 0.5rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.25rem; } .hupedia-edit-form { clear: both; margin: 1rem 0; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--hupedia-border, #a2a9b1); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: var(--hupedia-surface, #f8f9fa); color: var(--hupedia-text, #202122); } .hupedia-form-title { margin: 0 0 1rem; font: bold 1.1rem Georgia, serif; } .hupedia-form-title span { display: block; margin-top: 0.35rem; color: var(--hupedia-muted, #54595d); font: normal 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .hupedia-form-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 14rem), 1fr)); gap: 0.85rem; } .hupedia-form-row { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; gap: 0.3rem; font: 0.85rem system-ui, sans-serif; } .hupedia-form-row .hupedia-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--hupedia-border, #a2a9b1); border-radius: 0.2rem; background: #fff; color: #202122; } .hupedia-form-hint { margin: 1rem 0 0; color: var(--hupedia-muted, #54595d); font-size: 0.85em; } /* Measure the article, not the screen: the HUWiki sidebar can stay open. */ @container (max-width: 35rem) { .hupedia-infobox { float: none; width: 100%; max-width: none; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; } } /* Fallback for browsers without container queries. */ @media (max-width: 600px) { .hupedia-infobox { float: none; width: 100%; max-width: none; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; } } "}}}
